thread:
nina: Quick thread to lock down launch gating for the SLA Add-on (latency SLA + prioritized scheduling). We need final scope: tiers allowed, enforcement, and trial terms.
kevin: Product lean: ship as an add-on to Starter+ and above. Avoid adding to Free to keep simple.
ria: Sales pushed Starter customers wanting it. Can we allow Starter with a 3-month commitment?
kevin: Yes but require a minimum monthly fee for SLA Add-on on Starter: $1,200/mo. For Pro+ it's $600/mo.
nina: Enforcement model options: 1) soft-priority (best-effort with metrics) 2) hard-reservation (dedicated slots). Which for launch?
carter: Ops prefers soft-priority for launch to avoid scheduler churn. Hard-reservation can come later as "Priority Dedicated" SKU.
ria: Customers asking for guarantee will expect credits on breach. What's the credit policy? Support-bot: Default policy draft: 10% monthly credit per missed objective, capped at 50%.
kevin: Billing: represent as separate line item SKU SLA-PRIO, with metadata for tier and commitment term. Need to update ratecard.
nina: Trial terms: allow 14-day trial with full feature but require billing account; auto-convert unless canceled. Finance already said trials must be flagged in invoices.
carter: Telemetry gating: must show p50/p95/p99 per-tenant and per-route for customers in the SLA pool. Also need an internal dashboard for escalations.
ria: Launch criteria checklist suggestion: - >=2 paying customers on Starter or Pro, - infra telemetry live, - billing tests pass, - public docs + sales one-pager.
kevin: Also require runbook for breach investigation and standardized credit calculation. Ops to own runbook.
nina: Decision: Launch pilot with soft-priority add-on (SLA-PRIO SKU). Starter eligible with min $1.2k/mo commit. Offer route-scoped visibility (metrics only) but not route-scoped billing yet.
carter: Follow-ups: infra epic for metrics (owner @carter, ETA 3w), billing changes (owner @kevin, ETA 2w), sales one-pager (owner @ria, ETA 3 days), runbook (owner @carter, ETA 2w).
kevin: I'll create SKU IDs and update the ratecard. Also will add credit policy to billing doc.
ria: I'll prep pilot outreach template and coordinate two target customers that asked earlier.
nina: Great. I'll post these action items to the product board and schedule a pilot kickoff. :sparkles:
